hotspots.title: Tech‑Sector Visa Attack
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is suspending major tech firms—including Microsoft, Adobe, and others—from a green‑card program, accusing them of visa fraud and replacing American workers. The move has sparked fierce backlash from the companies and heated debate over immigration policy.
hotspots.affect: Intense partisan outrage over perceived anti‑tech bias and claims of protecting white American men fuel a charged narrative.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Blitz
hotspots.blurb: President Trump is crisscrossing the country with rallies in San Antonio, Syracuse, Alaska, and Texas, positioning himself as the linchpin of the upcoming midterm elections and drawing massive crowds while critics decry the politicization of public events.
hotspots.affect: The rallies generate triumphal framing for supporters and alarm among opponents, making the tour a focal point of partisan fervor.

hotspots.title: Immigration Enforcement Crackdown
hotspots.blurb: New investigations and lawsuits reveal a surge in immigration enforcement, including the detention of over 500 U.S. citizens, a push to “fight back” against Somali immigrants in Minnesota, and probes into nine universities for alleged visa fraud.
hotspots.affect: The story blends fear of governmental overreach with claims of protecting national security, driving strong emotional reactions on both sides.

hotspots.title: Frp Populist Surge & Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Norway’s Progress Party (Frp) enjoys record‑high poll numbers while simultaneously grappling with internal disputes over massive payouts to party leaders and criticism over service failures on Askøy, sparking intense debate within the party’s base.
hotspots.affect: The juxtaposition of soaring popularity and scandal creates a volatile mix of triumph and grievance among supporters and opponents.
